# Orbit Toolbox（轨道工具箱）

> 免费开源、uTools 风格的插件化开发者工具箱（Electron，Windows / macOS / Linux）。一切工具皆插件：安装 = 复制一个文件夹，全局热键一键呼出；内置 AI Agent 对话、截图悬浮、剪贴板历史、JSON 编辑器等 12 个插件，支持工作流编排与 MCP 生态。

Orbit Toolbox is a free, open-source (AGPLv3, commercial license available) uTools-style pluggable developer toolbox built on Electron with no frontend framework and no bundler. Every tool is a plugin: enable/disable on demand, summon with global hotkeys, install by dropping a folder into the plugin directory. Ships with a local AI agent (OpenAI / Claude protocol compatible, MCP marketplace, subagents, long-term memory), screenshot pinning, clipboard history, JSON editor, and more.

## 指南

- [简介](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/guide/introduction.html): 产品定位、微核 + 插件架构、技术选型与内置能力一览
- [快速开始](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/guide/getting-started.html): 安装运行、打包发布、CI/CD
- [架构总览](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/guide/architecture.html): 主进程 / 渲染层 / 插件系统协作方式
- [安全模型](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/guide/security.html): contextIsolation + sandbox、受控 IPC、plugin:// 协议防护

- [后端模块](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/plugin/backend.html): 主进程后端与 ctx API
- [独立窗口](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/plugin/windows.html): 插件自有窗口与 plugin:// 资源加载
- [工作流与能力](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/plugin/workflows.html): 触发器、步骤链、插件能力节点与数据管道
- [设计系统与主题](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/plugin/theming.html): light-dark() CSS 设计令牌
- [调试与测试](https://ikaros-521.github.io/orbit-tools/plugin/debugging.html): 插件调试与测试方法
